description: Evidence manifest for proving the production platform frontend passed browser QA against the central backend and provider contract routes.
rules: auth_flow_verified, central_backend_verified, and provider_contract_routes_verified must be true
every required view must be verified
console_errors and failed_requests must be empty
at least one screenshot record is required
screenshot relative_path values must be safe relative paths
screenshot sha256 values must be 64 lowercase hex characters
notes: This validator checks captured frontend QA metadata only. It does not run browsers, call networks, log in, or inspect screenshot files.
